title: 50 things to do in bed instead of scrolling
format: growing.diaries 8-slide checklist: hook over one candid photo with a grey save aside, five 10-item checklists (heading + 1–10 counter, two photos, two columns of circles), 'how i actually do it' with the app in a phone + App Store card, comment-bait closer with a round photo
why: Copies growing.diaries' 92K-like checklist slide for slide (8 slides, white page, lowercase, the app only on the 'how i actually do it' slide, a 'which one tonight' closer). Every item can be done without leaving the bed, so the list answers the exact moment the app creates: apps asleep, still awake. Photos are one person's lamp-lit bedroom, matching the ref's candid same-account look.
caption: for when your apps are asleep and you aren't yet #nightroutine #screentime #bedtimeroutine #doomscrolling
sound: soft, sleepy lo-fi at low volume (the ref has no saved sound)
check: slide 7: 'at 11 my apps go to sleep … i grab a number off the list' must be true for you (your real bedtime, or change 11)
slide 8: 'i'm on #3 (moon phases)' must be true; swap in the item you're actually doing
slide 7: the phone shows the real shield render (13-shield-night), not a mock
AI-made photos (all 12; one person seen from behind on slide 1, no faces): turn on TikTok's AI-generated label
promo: turn on TikTok's "Your brand" disclosure

slides.title:
50 things to do in bed
instead of scrolling
slides.aside: (save this for the next time it's 1am and you're "just checking one thing")

slides.heading: teach yourself something
items: fold a paper crane from memory
memorize one short poem
learn the phases of the moon
find 5 countries you've never heard of
learn to shuffle cards like a dealer
learn 3 knots with a shoelace
read one chapter of a history book
learn every bone in your hand
learn to count to 20 in a new language
memorize the planets in order (again)

slides.heading: make something
items: draw your own hand
crochet one granny square
write a haiku about your ceiling
draw the floor plan of your dream house
write the worst song you can
fold a paper star
write tomorrow's list in your nicest handwriting
doodle everyone you saw today
write a letter you'll never send
start a tiny zine about your week

slides.heading: slow down
items: give yourself a hand massage
legs up the wall for 5 minutes
drink something warm, slowly
put on the good socks
listen to one album start to finish
read a poem out loud, quietly
write 3 things that went fine today
stretch your hips without getting up
turn every light off but one
read until your eyes give up

slides.heading: with whoever's in your bed
items: play cards on the duvet
read to each other
rank your top 5 movies, then fight
ask "best part of your day?"
plan a trip on paper
play 20 questions
draw each other badly
tell how you met, but wrong
thumb war, best of 7
pet the cat until it leaves

slides.heading: when you can't sleep
items: write down what's looping, close the notebook
walk through your old house, room by room
name a city for every letter
say the alphabet backwards
replay your favorite movie in your head
list every teacher you ever had
breathe in 4, out 8, ten times
plan your perfect day, hour by hour
write a note to your younger self
just lie there. it still counts

slides.heading: how i actually do it
slides.text:
at 11, my apps _go to sleep_

so when my thumb opens tiktok anyway, it gets _this screen_ and i grab a number off the list

*(they wake up once i'm out of bed. link in bio)*

slides.question: which one are you doing tonight? 👇
lines: i'm on #3. still can't tell waxing from waning
the app that puts my apps to sleep is the link in bio 🤍
